  "error_code" text,
  "id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "ran_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "rows_upserted" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "source" text DEFAULT 'kasi_special_days' NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "year" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_holiday_sync_error_16e180e3" CHECK ((status = 'failed') = (error_code IS NOT NULL)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_holiday_sync_rows_74c43965" CHECK (rows_upserted >= 0 AND (status = 'success' OR rows_upserted = 0)),
  CONSTRAINT "ck_holiday_sync_source_f9aad6bf" CHECK (source = 'kasi_special_days'),
  CONSTRAINT "holiday_sync_runs_status_check_53a996d1" CHECK ("status" IN ('success', 'failed'))
)
